title: phleum asperum var. japonicum
intro: Phleum asperum var. japonicum, commonly known as Japanese meadow-grass, is a plant species that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Phleum asperum var. japonicum include antispasmodic and expectorant effects, which help relieve coughs and respiratory issues. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
